title: Enhancing Sentiment Classification on Small Datasets through Data Augmentation and Transfer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small-scale sentiment classification often suffers from data scarcity, which limits the generalization ability of the models. This study evaluates and compares the effectiveness of three data augmentation strategies: Easy Data Augmentation (EDA), back-translation, and contextual token substitution (nlpaug-style), with both traditional machine learning classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest) and transformer-based models (BERT). We perform a comprehensive empirical comparison with low-resource sentiment datasets by summarizing the results of recent studies and performing targeted head-to-head experiments. Our findings indicate that all augmentation methods improve performance. Contextual augmentation yields the most consistent gains for BERT models, while EDA and back-translation provide greater benefits for traditional classifiers. translated_title: 通过数据增强与迁移学习提升小规模数据集上的情感分类
translated_abstract: 小规模情感分类常常受到数据稀缺问题的困扰，这限制了模型的泛化能力。本研究评估并比较了三种数据增强策略的有效性：简易数据增强、回译和上下文词替换（nlpaug风格），并将其分别应用于传统机器学习分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林）和基于Transformer的模型（BERT）。我们通过总结近期研究结果并进行针对性的直接对比实验，在低资源情感数据集上进行了全面的实证比较。研究结果表明，所有数据增强方法均能提升性能。其中，上下文增强为BERT模型带来了最稳定的增益，而EDA和回译则为传统分类器带来更大的收益。这些见解有助于指导针对不同模型类型选择合适的数据增强技术。
tldr: 本研究比较了EDA、回译和上下文词替换三种数据增强方法在传统机器学习分类器与BERT模型上的效果，发现上下文增强对BERT模型增益最稳定，而EDA和回译更适合提升传统分类器的性能。
en_tdlr: This study compares three data augmentation strategies (EDA, back-translation, and contextual token substitution) across traditional machine learning classifiers and BERT, finding that contextual augmentation yields the most consistent gains for BERT, while EDA and back-translation benefit traditional classifiers more.
